work_summary: Shipped the live-chat sidebar row-jump fix as PR #182 (branch fix/live-chat-sidebar-row-resort, 5 commits, pushed). PR body documents the full root-cause chain and the deploy-order safety. tsc + eslint clean, vitest 462/462, pytest 799/799.
